content: audit-ci (IBM) supports npm/yarn/pnpm/bun, audit-ci.jsonc config with allowlist array (GHSA/CVE ids, optional expiry+reason), severity threshold. Runs npm audit --workspaces from repo root for monorepo coverage. HOWEVER verified via GitHub API: last release v7.1.0 and last commit both 2024-07-03 — dormant ~2 years as of 2026-08-20, 17 open issues, 3 open unmerged PRs. Not recommended for new adoption.
